messages:
Ava (Marketing): Quick sync 3 we need a post-webinar nurture + lead routing plan for yesterday's benchmarking webinar. Key goals: trial signups (primary), content engagement (secondary).
Ravi (Growth): Do we send the same replay to attendees and no-shows? also want to test subject lines & CTA placement.
Ava (Marketing): Plan: send replay to both, but different copy. Attendees get 'thanks + next steps', no-shows get 'here's what you missed'.
Maya (Content): I'll write two copy tracks: short exec and long technical. Also supply 2 subject lines per audience. Deliverable Wed EOD.
Jon (Analytics): Segment defs: attended (>=10% watch), high_engage (>=50% watch or asked_question), reg_no_show, clicked_replay. I'll wire tracking events webinar_replay_click and webinar_watch_pct.
Elena (Demand Gen): Routing rules: watch_pct >=50% OR asked_question -> tag "webinar_hot" -> route to SDR Pool A. reg_no_show who click replay -> nurture, route to SDR Pool B.
Nora (Ops): Ops notes: suppress current trial users and unsubscribes; throttle ESP to 10k/hr; ensure dedupe for newsletter list. I'll manage suppression and send windows.
sequence-bot: Recording uploaded: https://drive.redwood.example/webinars/benchmark-gen2-2026-03-19.mp4
Ava (Marketing): Proposed cadence:
0h: Replay + TL;DR + primary CTA (attended + reg_no_show)
24h: Deep-dive blog + secondary CTA (reg_no_show only)
72h: Case study + invite to office hours (attended)
7d: Last-chance trial offer + product tour (all)
Ravi (Growth): A/B test subject lines: A) "Benchmark results you can run today" vs B) "How we cut inference cost by 3x". Test CTA header vs footer.
Maya (Content): I'll add a social-proof line and a chart image for the long copy.
Jon (Analytics): Experiment id webinar_post_v2. UTM tags: utm_campaign=webinar_bench_2026, utm_medium=email, utm_content=variantA/B. I'll track open->replay_click->signup funnel.
Elena (Demand Gen): CRM fields needed on lead push: watch_pct, q_count, last_interaction_ts, utm_campaign, utm_content, pql_webinar_hot (boolean).
Nora (Ops): CRM mapping ok. Suppression window = 14 days. I'll coordinate with Zapier for field mappings and set bounce/retry logic.
Ava (Marketing): Owners: Maya copy by Wed EOD; Ravi sequence + A/B by Thu AM; Jon analytics by Thu EOD; Nora suppression by Fri. @Elena confirm SDR routing.
Elena (Demand Gen): Confirmed. I'll update SDR playbook and set nightly sync for leads tagged pql_webinar_hot.
Ravi (Growth): Can we surface replay-watch heatmap for SDRs to prioritize?
Jon (Analytics): Adding watch_heatmap to lead profile API in 48h.
Ava (Marketing): Thanks team 3 post updates here. If blockers arise, flag immediately. :rocket:
